flags: FHWA’s combined multi-state entry labels Historic Route 66 both All-American Road and National Scenic Byway. These labels are attributed at that scope; the cache does not establish a separate Missouri All-American Road award. Its length and drive-time estimates are not Missouri-only and are omitted.

The strip map contains multiple alignments and resets mileage for Kirkwood and Gray Summit. Moments follow the primary Joplin-to-St. Louis direction. The overview is a sequence of places, not a continuous navigation instruction across every former alignment.
Dropped the current present-tense Joplin zigzag, which describes a historical alignment rather than the whole present corridor. Its mine-cave-in explanation is supported but omitted for focus.

Dropped the current two-dogleg superlative and Devils Elbow’s present car-access promise. 41.txt combines a 2014 reopening with stale “in the process of renovation” text; no current county or bridge-manager confirmation is cached.
Dropped Dill’s bumper-sticker invention claim: the cache asserts it only in 42.txt, without corroborating primary evidence. No current landmark was dropped.
Chain of Rocks walking/cycling use is explicitly supported by 43.txt; checked date records review of the supplied cache, not a live operational check. No bridge-manager page is cached.
